name: s1
title: Call of Duty: Advanced Warfare (S1)
note: Addresses from the decrypted MP exe (s1_mp64_ship.exe, FileVersion 1.22.0.1), rewritten flat (raw offset = RVA). Stream primitives found 2026-09-25 by disassembly from DB_LoadXFile (0x242200, the only reference to 'S1ff0100'), which checks the zone version 0x72e every installed zone carries.

ghidra.epilogue_tags_note: the stream stack depth the pop decrements

rva_note: file_read(dst, n, 0) is the decompressed-stream read (its body is obfuscated: hooked, never run). As in IW6 there is no string primitive: Load_XStringCustom (load_string) calls file_read one byte at a time, folded back into one string read by stream.byte_strings. load_string_ptr is the script-string variant (reads, then SL_GetString). insert_ptr reserves an 8-byte slot in block 3 for a resident pointer. alloc aligns the block cursor to 4 and returns it.

asset_dispatch.note: the game's asset loop body: Load_Stream(flag, varXAsset, 16), then Load_XAssetHeader (0x25ba10) switches on the type and calls the type's loader with its var global set.

stream.pointer_ifs_note: the string loaders (17 tables, f25d990 the asset names) test their field as an IF chain (`!= 0`, then the inline marker): a back reference is the `!= 0` arm with no marker, which the walk records only with this (113,463 on the sample, every one placed by the layout)

temp_block_keep.note: pop (0x278bc0) rewinds the temp block (0) to the pushed position; skipped

release.note: 2026-09-27: the C++ walker reads exactly the emulator's recording on all 3004 zones (2950 are under release-check's 256 MB measure cap); occurrences_min stays 0 while the check has inexact occurrences

zone_load.note: the tail of DB_LoadXFile (0x242200): the 0x48-byte XFile, then the 0x28-byte XAssetList raw-read into a static; under push(3) the script strings (0x252fb0) and XGlobals (0x25c9d0) load through their own readers; under push(3) the asset array is allocated, Load_Stream-ed, and each entry dispatched with varXAsset = &list[i].
